notes: CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5808, PB5885 LANDED). Every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure is asked, in BindStatement, whether the emitter-verified store classification (BoundStores.StoresInto) stores into a storage-related item of any report's control data item: SameStorageLine is the item, a group containing it, an item subordinate to it, or an item that shares a byte with it through a REDEFINES or RENAMES (the layout's StorageExtent overlap, the same relation ReportSectionBinder.ControlDataReferenceOf asks of SR5 of the 1985 SOURCE rule; a table is every occurrence; an unprovable extent is not asked). The classification counts the stores an input-output statement makes through its file connector without naming the item (kb/Work PB5885; PlaceBuilder.ConnectorStores places them): READ and RETURN into the record area of every record description of the file and of a SAME RECORD AREA file and into the DEPENDING ON item, READ into the RELATIVE KEY item, CLOSE, DELETE, OPEN, READ, REWRITE, START, UNLOCK and WRITE into the FILE STATUS item, a sequential-access relative WRITE into the RELATIVE KEY item, and the implicit READ and WRITE of SORT and MERGE USING and GIVING. COBOL2378, one diagnostic per store, citing the edition's own rule. A BY REFERENCE CALL argument / INVOKE write-back is not counted: whether the callee alters it is not decidable from the source element.
